review.posthog_relevance: Adds client-side validation and error handling for warehouse connector file uploads, preventing invalid configurations from reaching backend processing.
review.reason: Adds a missingUploadedFileKeys utility and UnusableUploadedFileError class, and integrates checks into payload construction to reject warehouse connector uploads lacking required keys. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in configuration reliability and error handling. However, the backend implementation and complete connector configuration are not shown, so systemic
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on frontend and test changes; backend compatibility and complete error recovery are unverified.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the connector configuration or the backend API changes that define the required keys and the complete error handling flow. While the frontend adds checks, the backend and connector configuration are not shown, making it impossible to assess the systemic reliability or backend compatibility. No score assigned.
